acceptance_mapping.1_connector_dataset: TaifexDerivativesChipAdapter handles taifex_ssf_contracts (taifex_ssf_normalized_rows, parse_taifex_stock_lists_units, _decode_taifex_bytes utf-8-sig, _normalize_ssf_underlying_code), preserves listed regular-session contract-month rows with settlement_price=None when SettlementPrice is nonnumeric/nonpositive so front-month identity is not lost before month selection, and attaches scope-aware snapshot metadata (snapshot_scope_mode, snapshot_scope, snapshot_underlyings, snapshot_contracts, snapshot_contract_ids, snapshot_absent_contracts) plus durable dated tombstone rows when a completed snapshot produces no in-scope contract rows (including when contracts are removed from both margin and market tables); connector definition and catalog list the dataset; tests in test_taiwan_official_connectors.py use the committed fixtures
acceptance_mapping.2_active_universe_rule: SourceUpdateRule taifex_ssf_contracts (core tier, symbol_scope active_tw_paper_persona_underlyings, partition raw/taifex/ssf/date=YYYY-MM-DD/, normalized/taifex_ssf_contracts, 2555 days) resolves active Taiwan paper persona underlyings via resolve_active_tw_paper_persona_underlyings (excluding research/research-only, live and inactive/paused/retired members or persona bindings) and populates contracts for provider_adapters._taifex while leaving the existing two TAIFEX chip rules unchanged; test_active_universe.py covers research/live/inactive exclusion, governed persona inputs, and fanout-to-provider execution
acceptance_mapping.3_contract_master: ContractMaster.from_ssf_normalized_row(s) and ssf_tick_size in services/data-plane/models/contract_master.py derive real tick_size from underlying_kind and settlement_price per https://www.taifex.com.tw/cht/2/sTF (amended by 台期交字第1150001529號函 effective 2026-07-06: 2330 QFF/CDF at 2133 -> 1.0, 2317 DHF at 225 -> 0.5, 0050 SRF/NYF ETF at 92.35 -> 0.05), record the official source in metadata_json.tick_size_source, rank both underlying coverage (run_key) and per-(contract, month) winning rows (sort_key) by authoritative (effective_market_date, effective_margin_date, available_time, ingest_time, _file_run_seq) so older market-date snapshots replayed with later available_time/ingest_time cannot overwrite or evict newer snapshots and stay aligned with read_normalized_ssf_rows/build_candidates, skip unpriced winning contract-month rows without falling back to stale snapshots, evict contracts removed in newer covering snapshots (including empty scoped tombstone snapshots and >6 random ingest-<uuid> files), and fail closed when latest snapshot coverage is truncated or ambiguous; no second model; test_data_plane_schemas.py::TestContractMasterFromSsfDataset
acceptance_mapping.5_exclusion_rules: read_normalized_ssf_rows ranks candidate storage files by authoritative snapshot chronology (effective_market_date, effective_margin_date, available_time, ingest_time) rather than lexicographic ingest-<uuid> filename so >MAX_FILES random ingest runs cannot hide a newer covering snapshot behind older high-hex run IDs, and fails closed when scan/file/row bounds or conflicting random-run ties prevent establishing latest coverage; contract/month snapshots are scoped to the newest applicable covering snapshot before per-(contract, month) deduplication and nearest-month selection; unpriced nearest-month rows are preserved through normalization and rejected after nearest-month selection without falling back to a farther month or older snapshot; empty completed snapshots emit dated scope tombstones so contracts removed from both margin and market tables are evicted from storage without clobbering other scopes; stale Date, missing margin, zero volume and open interest, non-nearest month, adjusted codes, spread rows, and >6 random ingest-<uuid> normalization-to-storage-to-reader regressions each tested; cash share stays

deviations_and_unverified: No bounded reader for normalized datasets existed in the repository. instrument_candidates.read_normalized_ssf_rows is a new bounded reader (partition, file, byte and row limits) over the layout MarketDataStorageWriter writes; no production caller supplies normalized_root yet (wiring belongs to the policy task).

build_candidates takes the cash share price and its date from the caller (the D-1 close the signal context carries); without it the cash candidate has price null, max_units_by_risk 0 and a cash_price_unavailable source ref.
Cash share candidate fee_per_unit_per_side and tax_rate_per_side are 0.0: share commission and securities transaction tax are not on the TAIFEX fee page and are ledger-owned.

max_units_by_risk: futures = min(floor(available_cash / initial margin), floor((gross_limit - gross_used) / (price x multiplier))); cash share = floor(min(available_cash, gross_limit - gross_used) / price); a missing limit or cash figure yields 0. risk_budget keys available_cash, gross_limit, gross_used are this task's contract.

Last trading day is the third Wednesday, shifted to the next trading day for caller-supplied holidays; holiday-shift correctness against the official TAIFEX calendar is unverified. The normalized row carries last_trading_day_basis third_wednesday_no_holiday_shift.
The previous trading day uses weekdays minus caller-supplied holidays; no calendar reader was bound.

Existing test test_active_universe_fanout_keeps_taifex_market_context_unsymbolized was narrowed to exclude the new dataset from its chip-job set (its assertions on the two chip datasets are unchanged) and a new test covers the new rule.
